labels.example: in the last 10 minutes 54% of new same-day option volume was calls, against 52% since the open: a 2-point swing to calls, higher than 12 of the last 17 sessions at this minute, top third: a shift to calls for this time; new volume was above the too-thin line for this time, so it is not too thin to judge
labels.computed_how: difference of gex_views.vol_side_by_strike across diary rows 10 minutes apart; the swing (new call share less the day's) ranked against the same swing at this minute on up to the last 20 sessions' diaries, needing same_clock_min_sessions, in thirds; 'too thin to judge' when new contracts rank under thin_volume_pct of the same 10 minutes on those sessions

labels.name: options.flow_lean_30
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes the near-price 0DTE tape leaned toward buying calls and selling puts by 0.06 of signed premium above its usual level for this half hour, higher than 17 of the last 20 sessions at this minute, at or past the 80% rank line
labels.computed_how: aggressor-signed premium, the median of up to the last 20 sessions at this minute removed, ranked against those sessions (needing same_clock_min_sessions)

labels.name: options.premium_burst_5m
labels.example: in the last 5 minutes near-price 0DTE premium traded was in the top fifth for these minutes, higher than 17 of the last 19 sessions at this minute; 46% of its premium whose side could be told was calls bought or puts sold, higher than 5 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, bottom third: a bearish lean
labels.computed_how: tape premium per 5 minutes ranked by clock minute against up to the last 20 sessions' tapes, needing same_clock_min_sessions; the aggressor-signed bullish premium share ranked against the same five minutes' share on those sessions, burst or not, in thirds

labels.name: options.premium_pace_30
labels.example: near-price 0DTE premium traded in the last 30 minutes is in the top fifth for this half hour, higher than 17 of the last 20 sessions at this minute
labels.computed_how: tape premium per 30 minutes ranked against the same minutes on up to the last 20 sessions' tapes, needing same_clock_min_sessions, in fifths

labels.name: options.quote_liquidity
labels.example: over the last 5 minutes 25-40 delta same-day quotes have been 10 cents wide, their usual width for this time, with a median 225 contracts displayed, a middling book for this time, between the top and bottom fifths, higher than 9 of the last 14 sessions at this minute
labels.computed_how: lob_flow sweeps depth ranked against the same minute on up to the last 20 sessions, needing same_clock_min_sessions, in fifths; the spread against their median

labels.name: options.strike_defense
labels.example: of the book's magnet and walls, the strikes the collector tests, the nearest where same-day quotes keep getting hit is 0.08 sigma above price, farther than the nearest one on 8 of the last 17 sessions at this minute, middle third: within reach; it was hit 478 times in the last 15 minutes, at least the 10-hit minimum; market makers refilled its quotes at price at some point in those 15 minutes on 351 of them (73%), higher than 4 of the last 17 sessions at this minute, below the middle: abandoned
labels.computed_how: lob_flow quote refill events at the book's magnet and walls; the nearest strike hit defense_min_events times or more; its distance in sigma ranked against the nearest contested strike's at this minute on up to the last 20 sessions (each in its own ruler, estimated days out), the top third out of reach and the label omitted; its refill share ranked against those sessions' at this minute, defended at or above half_rank

labels.name: overnight.bond_gap
labels.example: at 09:28 ten-year Treasury futures stand 0.21% above their 16:00 price; over the last 20 nights they moved 0.18% per 1% in S&P futures, the other way, so they point S&P futures 0.35 sigma below where they stand, higher than 3 of the last 20 nights' readings, bottom third
labels.computed_how: /ZN's move in percent since futures' 16:00 price, divided by a fit's beta over the last {night_rank_count} nights (bonds' move per S&P futures' move, through zero, so the fit sets the sign and nothing is assumed), less the move /ES made: where bonds point S&P futures, less where they stand, in the pre-open ruler, ranked in thirds against the same reading on those nights (at least {overnight_rank_min_nights} with both measured on one contract); each move on one contract (rolls.same_contract); no bitcoin, which is btc_overnight_vs_futures; a night spanning a market holiday or following a half day is not ranked; it sleeps when bonds and S&P futures show no steady link: leaving out a single night turns the fit's sign
labels.source: the overnight store (state/spx_jev/overnight/{day}.jsonl): Schwab /ZN and /ES extended-hours bars, contract stamped

labels.name: overnight.es_move
labels.example: at 09:28 S&P futures are 0.44 sigma of the pre-open ruler above their 16:00 price, a move larger than 15 of the last 20 nights' moves to this time, top third
labels.computed_how: /ES's newest close by the read against its close at futures' 16:00 price on the same contract (roll guard: a night the roll table puts a roll between the two prices is omitted, and so is one whose quoted contract the table has not reached), in the pre-open ruler (the median morning anchor of the last sessions, rulers.normal_day_sigma, stamped on the record); its size is |move| in percent of price ranked against the same move to the same minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior nights (roll, holiday and half-day, and short nights left out; at least {overnight_rank_min_nights} usable, else omitted), stated as 'larger than N of the last M nights' moves' and its third (bottom/middle/top); night_ranks.es_move; no straddle clause (no chain trades before the open); a night spanning a market holiday or following a half day is not ranked
labels.source: the overnight store (state/spx_jev/overnight/{day}.jsonl): Schwab /ES extended-hours 1- and 5-minute bars as the read saw them, contract stamped

labels.name: overnight.gap_origin
labels.example: at 09:28 S&P futures stand 0.50 sigma below their 16:00 price, a move larger than 12 of the last 17 nights' moves to this time, top third; the most unusual stretch was Asia's session (18:00 to 02:30), down 0.45 sigma, larger than 16 of the last 17 nights' moves over the same stretch, top third
labels.computed_how: each stretch of the night (story.py: after_close, asia, europe_open, europe_morning, pre_report, report_window, last_stretch; an unfinished one cut at the read's clock) measured on /ES (night_ranks.window_move) and ranked by |move| in percent against the same stretch on up to the last {night_rank_count} nights (night_ranks.prior_window_nights); the stretch ranked most unusual names the option: after_close or asia made_early, europe_open or europe_morning made_in_europe, report_window made_at_release on a day with a report before the open, pre_report or last_stretch made_late (and report_window on a day with no report); a stretch across a roll or without its bars is left out; a night spanning a market holiday or following a half day is not ranked; on a morning with no report the report window is named by its clock, '08:30 to 08:45 (no report today)'
labels.source: the overnight store (state/spx_jev/overnight/{day}.jsonl): Schwab /ES extended-hours 1- and 5-minute bars as the read saw them, contract stamped; calendar pre_open rows (listed and read from pre_open_covers_from, 2026-08-01) for the release minute

labels.name: overnight.price_vs_range
labels.example: price is inside the overnight range now, 0.08 sigma below its high, within the 0.15 sigma near distance, after breaking above it at the open; it has not broken the low
labels.computed_how: spot (basis-adjusted) vs overnight high/low; earlier breaks today including the open; DARK: the overnight store (state/spx_jev/overnight/, saved at 09:26 and 16:20 ET) holds /ES's bars, but no session read measures the night's range from them yet (labels/gap_open.py)

labels.name: overnight.range
labels.example: last night's futures range spanned 0.48 sigma, from 0.21 sigma below yesterday's close to 0.27 above
labels.computed_how: /ES bars from futures' 16:00 price to 09:25, measured vs ES's own 16:00 price so the basis cancels; DARK: the overnight store (state/spx_jev/overnight/, saved at 09:26 and 16:20 ET) holds /ES's bars, but no session read measures the night's range from them yet (labels/gap_open.py)
labels.source: the overnight store (state/spx_jev/overnight/{day}.jsonl): Schwab /ES extended-hours 1- and 5-minute bars, contract stamped

labels.name: overnight.range_vs_normal
labels.example: since the 18:00 reopen S&P futures have ranged over 0.48 sigma of the pre-open ruler, wider than 16 of the last 20 nights' ranges to this time, top third: a wide night
labels.computed_how: /ES high-low range since the 18:00 reopen (bars the store's check flagged left out), in percent of price, ranked against the same range to the same minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior nights (roll, holiday and half-day, and short nights left out; at least {overnight_rank_min_nights} usable, else omitted) (night_ranks.window_range), in thirds; stated in the pre-open ruler. The thirds replace the fixed 0.7x and 1.3x lines of the 20-night median, which called 21% of nights quiet and 29% wide; a night spanning a market holiday or following a half day is not ranked
labels.source: the overnight store (state/spx_jev/overnight/{day}.jsonl): Schwab /ES extended-hours 1- and 5-minute bars as the read saw them, contract stamped

labels.name: overnight.release_reaction
labels.example: the 08:30 jobs report moved futures up 0.22 sigma of the pre-open ruler by 08:45, larger than 17 of the last 20 mornings' moves in that window, top third; since then they have given back 60% of it, past the half line
labels.computed_how: /ES from the release minute (story.release_minute: the first pre_open calendar row after 08:00 and before 08:45) to 08:45, ranked by |move| in percent against the same window on the last {night_rank_count} days, report or not (night_ranks.prior_window_nights), the bottom third shrugged; then 08:45 to the read against that reaction, judged against the {gap_half_share} half line; in the pre-open ruler; a window across a roll is left out. Asked on every report day, claims-only mornings included; a night spanning a market holiday or following a half day is not ranked
labels.source: the overnight store's /ES bars + calendar pre_open rows (listed and read from pre_open_covers_from, 2026-08-01)

labels.name: price.afternoon_leg
labels.example: since 14:00 price has fallen 0.07 sigma, larger than 8 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, middle third: a move; the day is 0.44 sigma above yesterday's close and price sits at 78% of today's range; the last 30 minutes fell 0.06 sigma
labels.computed_how: close of the 13:59 bar to now in sigma_anchor; its size ranked against the same measure to this clock on up to the last night_rank_count prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions), stated as 'larger than N of the last M sessions at this minute' and its third (bottom/middle/top); ties are not beaten; omitted under same_clock_min_sessions usable sessions, with the reason; each prior session's move over the same minutes to this clock in its own morning ruler, sessions whose ruler was estimated left out (ranks.move_rank); today's move ends at the row's live spot, each prior session's at the close of its last bar finished by the same clock (on a live tape the two are seconds apart; a bar-close end would measure a shorter window than the base whenever the bars stop) (the minutes since 14:00, from each session's own 13:59 close); bottom third = no real move; context clauses: day from prior close, day-range position, last 30 minutes

labels.name: price.day_character
labels.example: so far today, 30-minute stretches have been 1.58 times what their 5-minute pieces would suggest, higher than 13 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, top third: building
labels.computed_how: variance ratio of the day's overlapping 30-minute returns over its 5-minute returns since 10:00 (Lo and MacKinlay's bias-corrected form), ranked against the same measure to this clock on up to the last night_rank_count prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions), stated as 'higher than N of the last M sessions at this minute' and its third (bottom/middle/top); ties are not beaten; omitted under same_clock_min_sessions usable sessions, with the reason (each prior session's ratio from its own 10:00 to this clock; every prior session with bars counts, its ruler estimated or not, since no ruler scales this measure); bottom third = cancelling, middle = mixed, top = building

labels.name: price.day_move
labels.example: since the settled 09:35 open SPX has risen 0.24 sigma, larger than 7 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, middle third: a move
labels.computed_how: (spot - 09:34 close)/sigma_anchor; its size ranked against the same measure to this clock on up to the last night_rank_count prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions), stated as 'larger than N of the last M sessions at this minute' and its third (bottom/middle/top); ties are not beaten; omitted under same_clock_min_sessions usable sessions, with the reason; each prior session's move over the same minutes to this clock in its own morning ruler, sessions whose ruler was estimated left out (ranks.move_rank); today's move ends at the row's live spot, each prior session's at the close of its last bar finished by the same clock (on a live tape the two are seconds apart; a bar-close end would measure a shorter window than the base whenever the bars stop) (the minutes since 09:35, so every session's move runs from its own 09:34 close); bottom third = no real move, middle = a move, top = a strong move

labels.name: price.day_move_split
labels.example: SPX is 0.53 sigma above yesterday's close, further from it than 9 of the last 18 sessions at this minute, middle third: away from it; 0.30 sigma up came from the opening gap and 0.24 sigma up from trading since the open, so the gap is 56% of the day's move, at least half: most of it came from the gap
labels.computed_how: the price.vs_prior_close distance and its third, split into the gap (settled open - prior_close) and the trading since the settled open, all in sigma_anchor; once the distance is out of the bottom third, the gap's share of it against gap_half_share
labels.source: SPX 1-min bars (live Schwab $SPX; replay state/reversion/bars/{day}-SPX.json); state/reversion/{day}.jsonl

labels.name: price.day_range_position
labels.example: price is in the top band of today's range so far (past the 75% line), 96% of the way up
labels.computed_how: built (engine) with thirds; reworded to the top/bottom band set by range_top_share / range_bottom_share

labels.name: price.hour_one_way
labels.example: over the last 60 minutes price rose 0.29 sigma, larger than 16 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, top third: a strong move; it crossed its own hourly average 1 time, more often than 0 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, bottom third: one-way
labels.computed_how: net 60-minute move in sigma_anchor, its size ranked against the same measure to this clock on up to the last night_rank_count prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions), stated as 'larger than N of the last M sessions at this minute' and its third (bottom/middle/top); ties are not beaten; omitted under same_clock_min_sessions usable sessions, with the reason (each prior session's move over the same minutes to this clock in its own morning ruler, sessions whose ruler was estimated left out (ranks.move_rank); today's move ends at the row's live spot, each prior session's at the close of its last bar finished by the same clock (on a live tape the two are seconds apart; a bar-close end would measure a shorter window than the base whenever the bars stop)); and the count of 1-minute closes crossing the mean of the hour's closes, ranked the same way against the same hour's count on the prior sessions ('more often than'), every prior session with bars counting, its ruler estimated or not, since no ruler scales a count; crosses in the bottom third = one-way, else two-way

labels.name: price.move_shape
labels.example: the last half hour rose 0.13 sigma, larger than 16 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, top third: a strong move; one 5-minute stretch made 114% of it, past the 80% burst line; its net move was 0.18 of the distance travelled, more one-way than 10 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, middle third
labels.computed_how: the price.recent_move rank first (bottom third: no real move to shape); then the largest of the six 5-minute chunks over the net 30-minute move (burst line move_burst_share, a share of the move's own net) and path efficiency = net over the sum of 1-minute moves, today's and each prior session's alike from the close before the half hour through its finished bar closes, ranked against the same measure to this clock on up to the last night_rank_count prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions), stated as 'more one-way than N of the last M sessions at this minute' and its third (bottom/middle/top); ties are not beaten; omitted under same_clock_min_sessions usable sessions, with the reason; every prior session with bars counts, its ruler estimated or not, since no ruler scales this measure; bottom third = choppy

labels.name: price.prior_close_push
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes price rose 0.13 sigma away from yesterday's close, larger than 16 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, top third: a strong move; it now sits 0.53 sigma above it, further from it than 9 of the last 18 sessions at this minute, middle third: away from it; it has not crossed it in the last 30 minutes, though it did earlier today
labels.computed_how: the 30-minute move signed toward prior_close with the price.recent_move rank; the distance to prior_close with the price.vs_prior_close rank; crossing flags within the window and for the day
labels.source: SPX 1-min bars (live Schwab $SPX; replay state/reversion/bars/{day}-SPX.json); state/reversion/{day}.jsonl prior_close

labels.name: price.recent_move
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes price rose 0.13 sigma, larger than 16 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, top third: a strong move; the half hour closed between the top and bottom fifths of its own range
labels.computed_how: 30-minute close-to-close in sigma_anchor; its size ranked against the same measure to this clock on up to the last night_rank_count prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions), stated as 'larger than N of the last M sessions at this minute' and its third (bottom/middle/top); ties are not beaten; omitted under same_clock_min_sessions usable sessions, with the reason; each prior session's move over the same minutes to this clock in its own morning ruler, sessions whose ruler was estimated left out (ranks.move_rank); today's move ends at the row's live spot, each prior session's at the close of its last bar finished by the same clock (on a live tape the two are seconds apart; a bar-close end would measure a shorter window than the base whenever the bars stop); bottom third = no real move, middle = a move, top = a strong move; then the close-location clause (top fifth, bottom fifth or between, of the half hour's own range)

labels.name: price.session_extreme_recent
labels.example: SPX set a new session high 4 minutes ago, 0.05 sigma above the earlier high from 10:52
labels.computed_how: latest new session high/low within new_extreme_recent_min

labels.name: price.vs_prior_close
labels.example: price is 0.53 sigma above yesterday's close, further from it than 9 of the last 18 sessions at this minute, middle third: away from it
labels.computed_how: (spot - row prior_close)/sigma_anchor; its size ranked against the same measure to this clock on up to the last night_rank_count prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions), stated as 'further from it than N of the last M sessions at this minute' and its third (bottom/middle/top); ties are not beaten; omitted under same_clock_min_sessions usable sessions, with the reason; each prior session's diary row at this clock (its own spot against its own level, in its own morning ruler; sessions whose ruler was estimated left out; the rows are read once a read); bottom third = near it, middle = away from it, top = far from it

labels.name: price.vs_vwap
labels.example: price is 0.32 sigma above the day's volume-weighted average price, further from it than 17 of the last 18 sessions at this minute, top third: far from it; it last traded at the average 35 minutes ago
labels.computed_how: (spot - row vwap)/sigma_anchor; its size ranked against the same measure to this clock on up to the last night_rank_count prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions), stated as 'further from it than N of the last M sessions at this minute' and its third (bottom/middle/top); ties are not beaten; omitted under same_clock_min_sessions usable sessions, with the reason; each prior session's diary row at this clock (its own spot against its own level, in its own morning ruler; sessions whose ruler was estimated left out; the rows are read once a read); bottom third = at the average, middle = away from it, top = far from it; then minutes since a 1-minute bar spanned the average known when it finished

labels.name: price.vwap_reach
labels.example: the day's volume-weighted average price is 0.32 sigma below price, further than 17 of the last 18 sessions at this minute, top third: far from it, 1.6 typical 30-minute moves away
labels.computed_how: |spot - vwap| with the price.vs_vwap rank and its third, and in 30-minute reach units (R_h from ruler.flat_band_reach)

labels.name: range.first_hour
labels.example: price is above the first hour's high, 0.14 sigma beyond it; the first hour spanned 0.54 sigma; since 10:30 price broke above its high 29 minutes ago, reached 0.21 sigma beyond it, further than 8 of the 14 first-hour breaks the last 19 sessions had made by this minute, middle third, and never broke its low
labels.computed_how: current location against the first hour's high/low first; a break is a bar more than ib_break_sigma past an edge since 10:30, its reach the furthest a bar went past that edge in sigma_anchor, ranked against the same reach (the furthest past either first-hour edge) at this clock on those of up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions that had broken their first hour by then (a session with no break yet is left out, not counted as 0), each in its own morning anchor with 'ruler estimated' sessions left out (ranks.rank_sessions), at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them; with fewer the reach is said without a rank, and the label is omitted with the reason when one edge is broken and price is still beyond it (the only case the rank decides); said as 'further than N of the M first-hour breaks the last K sessions had made by this minute' and its third

labels.name: range.hour_vs_clock
labels.example: the last hour's high-low range is 0.59 sigma, wider than 19 of the last 19 sessions at this time of day, top third
labels.computed_how: 60-minute high minus low in sigma_anchor (at least 40 of its bars on file), ranked against the same 60 minutes to this clock at this clock on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions), each in its own morning anchor with 'ruler estimated' sessions left out, at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else the label is omitted with the reason; said as 'wider than N of the last M sessions at this time of day' and its third

labels.name: range.pace_vs_priced
labels.example: today's range so far is 1.10 of a one-sigma move for the 181 minutes since the open, larger than 15 of the last 19 sessions at this time of day, top third: over the usual pace
labels.computed_how: day high-low over sigma_anchor x sqrt(minutes/390), ranked against the same ratio at this clock on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions), each in its own morning anchor with 'ruler estimated' sessions left out, at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else the label is omitted with the reason; pace words by its third (under / near / over) and far over in the top fifth

labels.name: range.today_vs_normal
labels.example: today's range so far is 0.73% of its opening price, larger than 17 of the last 20 sessions at this time of day, top third
labels.computed_how: the day's high-low so far (spot included) over its first bar's open, ranked against the same share to this clock on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions; a share of price, so every session with bars counts), at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else omitted with the reason; said as 'larger than N of the last M sessions at this time of day' and its third

labels.name: ruler.flat_band_reach
labels.example: the next-30-minute flat band is 0.07 sigma; a typical 30-minute move now (tape and straddle combined) is 0.08 sigma, so the band covers 0.84 of it, more than on 14 of the last 16 sessions at this time of day, top third; the next-60-minute flat band is 0.11 sigma; a typical 60-minute move is 0.12 sigma, so the band covers 0.93 of it
labels.computed_how: band_pts / R_h, R_h = sqrt(T_h x E_h), T_h = tape unit x sqrt(h/5), E_h = em_points/0.68 x sqrt(h/minutes left); R_h = T_h while a tier-1 event is ahead; the 30-minute share ranked against the same share (rulers.typical_move on that session as it stood then, its em_points from its diary row within 10 minutes of the clock) at this clock on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions), each in its own morning anchor with 'ruler estimated' sessions left out, at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else the label is omitted with the reason; said as 'more than on N of the last M sessions at this time of day' and its third; the 60-minute share is given as a figure, unranked, since on every session its typical move is the 30-minute one grown by the same clock-set factor and its rank would repeat the 30-minute one
labels.source: SPX 1-min bars (live Schwab $SPX; replay state/reversion/bars/{day}-SPX.json); state/reversion/{day}.jsonl

labels.name: sectors.agreement_30m
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes 7 of 11 sector funds moved the index's way, each by a move above the bottom third of its own at this minute; that count is higher than 17 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, top third: one way; sector dispersion beyond each fund's usual multiple was 0.13 sigma, higher than 9 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, middle third: not wide
labels.computed_how: each of the 11 SPDRs' 30-minute move: it moved when its size is above the bottom third of its own on up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions at this minute; the count moving the index's way ranked against the same measure at this clock on up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions, needing {same_clock_min_sessions} (else the label is omitted with the reason), every session kept (a count is in no ruler; ties are not beaten); the dispersion (sd of beta residuals in SPX sigma) ranked the same way, each session in its own ruler (an estimated ruler sits out); each prior session counted with the same per-fund lines; top third = one way / wide
labels.source: Schwab 1-min bars via market_context.py, saved by the context job to state/spx_jev/context/{day}.jsonl (live) and state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (backfill: python -m spx_jev.market_context --backfill 2026-08-10); the symbol must be in market_context.SYMBOLS (11 SPDRs)

labels.name: shock.burst
labels.example: 60 minutes ago price fell 0.36 sigma in 5 minutes, larger than the biggest five-minute move of the hour to that minute on 19 of the last 19 sessions, past the shock rule; inside the first 15 minutes after the University of Michigan's consumer sentiment report at 10:00; the burst ended 55 minutes ago, older than the 10-minute fresh window; since then price has given back 83% of it, past the half line
labels.computed_how: each 5-minute window from the settled open ending in the last 60 minutes: |move| in sigma_anchor ranked against each prior session's biggest 5-minute move over the 60 minutes to the same clock, or from its settled open when that is shorter (the sentence names which), in its own morning anchor, ranked with ranks.rank_sessions against up to the last 20 prior sessions (newest first; a session whose morning ruler was estimated is left out), needing same_clock_min_sessions of them, else the label is omitted with the rank's reason; stated as 'N of the last M sessions'; a window passes the shock rule only when it beats every one of them (N equals M), the same rule at 10 sessions as at 20; overlapping passes are one burst, the largest; aftermath share kept against the half line

labels.name: shock.cross_asset
labels.example: during the shock the ten-year yield rose 0.5 basis points beyond its usual link to the index, more than on 16 of the last 19 sessions over the same five minutes, in the top fifth; semiconductors fell 0.18 sigma beyond theirs, their move the shock's way more than on 17 of the last 19 sessions over the same five minutes, in the top fifth, the shock's way; no megacap's share of it is measured, since their index weights are not on file; 11 of 11 sector funds fell with it, more than on 19 of the last 19 sessions over the same five minutes, in the top fifth, and NYSE TICK reached -806, at or past its bottom 5% band for those minutes, the shock's way; the defensive funds (staples, utilities, health care) rose 0.03 sigma beyond their usual link, against the shock, their move against the index more than on 12 of the last 19 sessions over the same five minutes, short of the top fifth, no defensive bid
labels.computed_how: each group's move over the burst minus its link to the index (slope through zero of 1-minute moves over the hour before) times SPX's move: $TNX in bp, SMH and the defensive funds' mean in index sigma, the count of the 11 sector funds moving the index's way; each ranked with ranks.rank_sessions against the same five minutes (same clock, same length), shock or not, fitted the same way on each day, on up to the last 20 prior sessions (newest first; a session whose morning ruler was estimated is left out), needing same_clock_min_sessions of them, else the label is omitted with the rank's reason; stated as 'N of the last M sessions' and its third; a group passes at the top fifth (top_fifth); NYSE TICK's bars against their same-minute tick_burst_pct bands over the last 20 sessions (ranks.tick_bands_by_minute); every sector fund needed
labels.source: Schwab 1-min bars via market_context.py, saved by the context job to state/spx_jev/context/{day}.jsonl (live) and state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (backfill: python -m spx_jev.market_context --backfill 2026-08-10); the symbol must be in market_context.SYMBOLS ($TNX/TLT, SMH, megacaps, 11 SPDRs, $TICK); the $TNX fallback is not usable after 15:00 (bars stop at 14:59)

labels.name: shock.vs_day_range
labels.example: the shock took price to a new session low, 0.16 sigma under the earlier low, which price has since pushed 0.04 sigma further, and price is 0.34 sigma above that new low, farther from it than 15 of the last 19 sessions sat from their own session low at this minute, top third, so it has given the new extreme up
labels.computed_how: the burst's extreme vs the session high/low before it; when it passed, price's distance back from the newest extreme since the burst, in sigma_anchor, ranked with ranks.rank_sessions against each session's distance from its same-side session extreme at this minute, in its own ruler, on up to the last 20 prior sessions (newest first; a session whose morning ruler was estimated is left out), needing same_clock_min_sessions of them, else the label is omitted with the rank's reason; stated as 'N of the last M sessions' and its third; the bottom third is still at the new extreme

labels.name: skew.put_tilt_vs_usual
labels.example: same-day 25-delta puts are priced 1.3 vol points above 25-delta calls, 0.09 of the at-the-money level; its tilt beats 1 of the last 16 sessions at 09:50: a flat tilt for this minute; the far-put wing (10-delta over 25-delta puts) is flatter than usual for this minute
labels.computed_how: (IV 25d put - IV 25d call)/ATM IV from the lob-flow tape's quotes in the minute to the read, ranked against the same tilt at the same minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions' tapes (each read as it was on file at that minute; 'ruler estimated' sessions left out), at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them; verdict 'a steep put tilt / a flat tilt / a usual tilt' by {skew_steep_rank} and {skew_flat_rank}, none under a call tilt; omitted (question asleep) under {same_clock_min_sessions} sessions or with a missing price; far-wing clause ranked the same way
labels.source: lob_flow tape backfill 22 sessions; native chain going forward

labels.name: skew.shift_vs_price
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes the gap between same-day put and call prices narrowed 0.014 of at-the-money vol while price rose 0.13 sigma; price explains a narrowing of 0.025, so puts got dearer by 0.012 beyond the move; ranked with puts getting dearest highest, higher than 15 of the last 17 sessions at this minute, top third
labels.computed_how: 30-minute change in the 1-remaining-sd put-call tilt minus the fitted beta x SPX move, signed, ranked against the same on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions' lob-flow tapes at this minute (each move in its own anchor, each tape as it was on file then), at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else omitted
labels.source: ts-sorted lob_flow tape quotes / native chain

labels.name: tape.unit_vs_normal
labels.example: the tape unit (the middle of the last three 5-minute ranges) is 0.10 sigma, wider than 14 of the last 19 sessions at 10:05, in the top third
labels.computed_how: state_builder.ruler + rulers.unit_rank in sigma_anchor: the unit ranked against the same three slices at this minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions, each in its own anchor with 'ruler estimated' sessions left out, at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them; omitted while held before 09:45

labels.name: tells.sector_lead_10m
labels.example: over the last 10 minutes semiconductors (SMH) ran 0.28 sigma above their usual multiple of the index, moved in line, between the top and bottom fifths for this time, higher than 15 of the last 19 sessions at this minute; financials (XLF) ran 0.11 sigma below their usual multiple of the index, broke away downward, in the bottom fifth for this time, higher than 2 of the last 19 sessions at this minute
labels.computed_how: 10-minute return minus beta x SPX return (the minutes since 09:31 before 09:41), in SPX sigma, signed and ranked against the same measure at this clock on up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions, needing {same_clock_min_sessions} (else the label is omitted with the reason), in fifths (XLF replaces KBE)
labels.source: Schwab 1-min bars via market_context.py, saved by the context job to state/spx_jev/context/{day}.jsonl (live) and state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (backfill: python -m spx_jev.market_context --backfill 2026-08-10); the symbol must be in market_context.SYMBOLS (SMH, XLF)

labels.name: vol.atm_iv_residual
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes same-day at-the-money vol fell 0.88 points while price rose 0.13 sigma; the rise alone explains a fall of 0.28, so vol ended 0.60 points below what price explains; ranked with vol furthest above what price explains highest, higher than 3 of the last 18 sessions at this minute, bottom third
labels.computed_how: 30-minute change in the diary's ATM 0DTE IV minus the fitted beta (about -2.2 vol points per sigma) x SPX move, signed, ranked against the same measure at the same clock minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions; each session's diary as its read at that minute had it, 'ruler estimated' sessions left out), at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else omitted with the reason (each session's SPX move in its own anchor); omitted in the last hour

labels.name: vol.front_fear_shift
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes nine-day VIX rose 0.19 points against the 30-day VIX, from 2.03 under it to 1.84 under it; ranked with nine-day VIX gaining highest, higher than 19 of the last 20 sessions at this minute, top third
labels.computed_how: change in (VIX9D - VIX) over 30 minutes, signed, ranked against the same change at this minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions' market context (state/spx_jev/context/bars carries $VIX and $VIX9D back to 2026-08), at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else omitted

labels.name: vol.realized_vs_clock
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes SPX's realized swing was 0.05 sigma, more than 1 of the last 19 sessions at this time of day, in the bottom fifth; its largest 10-minute move inside them was 0.03 sigma, larger than 4 of the last 19 sessions' largest in the same half hour, bottom third: no real move
labels.computed_how: sqrt(sum of squared 1-min close changes, >=25 bars)/sigma_anchor ranked against the same half hour on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions, each in its own anchor ('ruler estimated' sessions left out), at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, in fifths with the more-than-all flag, each named by its answer ('ordinary / busy / very busy for this half hour'); real-move clause, in the bottom fifth only: the half hour's largest {window_10_min}-minute move (measures.move_size, both ends inside it) ranked the same way against the same half hour's largest on those sessions, bottom third = no real move

labels.name: vol.realized_vs_clock_rank
labels.example: the last 30 minutes moved 1.86 times the usual pace for this half hour (its median on the last 19 sessions at this time of day), higher than 18 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, top third
labels.computed_how: 30-minute realized swing ranked against the same half hour on up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions, each in its own anchor, at least {same_clock_min_sessions}, said by its third; the multiple of their median is the figure

labels.name: vol.ruler_event_load
labels.example: normal: the same-day straddle prices a 30-minute move 0.34 times what the tape's recent 5-minute ranges scale to, higher than 1 of the last 17 sessions at 12:31 (in the bottom fifth); on the event calendar today: the University of Michigan's consumer sentiment report at 10:00; none of them is the Fed's rate decision, the Fed chair's testimony or the Fed chair's Jackson Hole speech; this morning's sigma ruler is 1.05 times its 19-session median, larger than 11 of the last 19 sessions' morning rulers, middle third
labels.computed_how: E30/T30 ratio ranked against the same at this minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions (fifths); the morning anchor ranked against up to the last {night_rank_count} trusted anchors (thirds; the multiple of their median is the figure); after a Fed event inside the digest window, the tape over the pre-event straddle ranked against the same on those sessions (thirds); each at least {same_clock_min_sessions} sessions, else omitted (the release clause says why); the event clause names every calendar row today and, when none is one of the loading events (LOADING_EVENTS: FOMC, Fed chair testimony, Jackson Hole), says so; the event clause needs context.event_clock

labels.name: vol.straddle_reprice_30
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes the same-day straddle for the rest of today ended 3.3% cheaper than the clock alone would have left it; ranked with richer highest, higher than 3 of the last 17 sessions at this minute, bottom third
labels.computed_how: (em_points now / em_points 30 minutes ago) / sqrt(minutes left now / minutes left then) - 1, signed, ranked against the same measure at the same clock minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions; each session's diary as its read at that minute had it, 'ruler estimated' sessions left out), at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else omitted with the reason

labels.name: vol.straddle_vs_clock
labels.example: the same-day straddle for the rest of today is 1.40 times its usual share of the opening straddle at 12:31 (its median on the last 17 sessions), higher than 16 of the last 17 sessions at this minute, top third
labels.computed_how: range_ruler.em_points over em_open x sqrt(minutes left/session minutes), ranked against the same measure at the same clock minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions; each session's diary as its read at that minute had it, 'ruler estimated' sessions left out), at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else omitted with the reason; the multiple of their median is the figure, the third the verdict

labels.name: vol.stress_path
labels.example: VIX 24.1, up 3.4 points since the open; session high 25.0 at 11:42, it has given back 21% of its rise from there, short of the 30% retreat share and at or past the 10% hold share; SPX sits 0.22 sigma above its session low from 11:40, further off its low than 8 of the last 10 sessions at this minute, top third; NYSE TICK's 1-minute lows reached the bottom 5% band for their minute 5 times in 30 minutes, at least the 3-reading cluster
labels.computed_how: written only when VIX's change from its open (diary vol_carry.vix) or its VIX/VIX3M's (diary vix_ts) is a rise higher than on every one of up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions at this minute, or VIX is above their highs, or VIX/VIX3M is at or over {vix_curve_flat} (inverted); the curve's level is not ranked (it drifts for weeks and tops its recent sessions on calm days); otherwise omitted so the question sleeps; SPX's distance off its session low in the morning anchor ranked against the same at this minute on those sessions in their own anchors (thirds); the TICK count against ranks.tick_bands_by_minute; the retreat share (stress_retreat_share, stress_hold_share); each rank at least {same_clock_min_sessions} sessions, else omitted
labels.source: state/reversion/{day}.jsonl range_ruler.vol_carry.vix, vix_ts; SPX bars; Schwab $TICK (context job)

labels.name: vol.term_structure
labels.example: VIX is 0.83 times three-month VIX, under the 1.00 inversion line; flatter than 8 of the last 18 sessions at this time, between the top and bottom fifths; nine-day VIX is 0.88 of VIX, under the inversion line; the curve has not inverted on any of the last 20 sessions
labels.computed_how: VIX/VIX3M (diary vix_ts) and VIX9D/VIX; the inversion line first, then the top/bottom-fifth rank ranked against the same measure at the same clock minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions; each session's diary as its read at that minute had it, 'ruler estimated' sessions left out), at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else omitted with the reason

labels.name: vol.vix_change
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes VIX fell 0.13 points, 0.87% of its 14.9 level, higher than 16 of the last 18 sessions at this minute, top fifth
labels.computed_how: |VIX change| over the window (30 minutes on 30-minute reads; 10 minutes in the opening lane, from the open's first print at 09:40) as a share of the level, ranked against the same measure at the same clock minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions; each session's diary as its read at that minute had it, 'ruler estimated' sessions left out), at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else omitted with the reason; said as its third, the top fifth apart
labels.source: state/reversion/{day}.jsonl range_ruler.vol_carry.vix (a live 1-2 minute series; changed 230 times in 266 rows on 09-25)

labels.name: vol.vix_on_shock
labels.example: since just before the shock, at 09:55, VIX ended 0.21 points above what price explains: it rose 0.61 points, and the 0.37 sigma drop alone would lift it 0.40; ranked with VIX furthest above what price explains highest, higher than 18 of the last 19 sessions from 09:55 to this minute, top third
labels.computed_how: VIX now minus 6 minutes before the shock, less the fitted beta x the price move over the same span, signed, ranked against the same minutes on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions, shock or not (each in its own anchor), at least {same_clock_min_sessions}, else omitted
labels.source: state/reversion/{day}.jsonl range_ruler.vol_carry.vix (live today); Schwab $VIX 1-min once the context job runs

labels.name: vol.vix_overnight_surprise
labels.example: VIX's first print today was 15.29, 0.27 below yesterday's last 15.56; after this morning's 0.30 sigma gap up it would normally sit near 15.05, so it is 0.24 points richer than the gap implies; ranked with richer highest, higher than 13 of the last 18 sessions' openings, top third
labels.computed_how: first diary row range_ruler.vol_carry.vix vs the prior day's last row, minus the fitted beta (about -1.7 points per sigma of gap) x the gap from yesterday's close to the settled open in the morning anchor; that surprise ranked (signed, richer highest) against the same surprise on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions (each its first diary VIX against the session before's last, its gap in its own anchor; a session whose session before has no diary on file, or whose anchor was estimated, is left out), at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else omitted; said by its third; asked at 09:35 only
labels.source: state/reversion/{day}.jsonl range_ruler.vol_carry.vix (today's first row, prior day's last row)

labels.name: vol.vix_since_1400
labels.example: since 14:00 VIX fell 0.07 points, 0.47% of its 14.9 level; ranked with a rise highest, higher than 4 of the last 18 sessions from 14:00 to this minute, bottom third
labels.computed_how: VIX now minus the newest row by 14:00, as a share of the level, signed, ranked against the same measure at the same clock minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions; each session's diary as its read at that minute had it, 'ruler estimated' sessions left out), at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else omitted with the reason

labels.name: vol.vix_vs_price
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes VIX ended 0.30 points (1.88% of VIX) above what price explains: it rose 0.57 points, and the 0.25 sigma SPX drop alone would lift it about 0.27; ranked with VIX furthest above what price explains highest, higher than 19 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, top third
labels.computed_how: 30-minute dVIX (diary) minus the fitted beta x the SPX move in the morning anchor, as a share of VIX, signed; ranked against the same measure at the same clock minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions (ranks.rank_sessions; each session's diary as its read at that minute had it, 'ruler estimated' sessions left out), at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else omitted with the reason (each session's SPX move in its own anchor)
labels.source: state/reversion/{day}.jsonl range_ruler.vol_carry.vix (live today); Schwab $VIX 1-min once the context job runs

labels.name: vol.vvix_vs_vix
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes VVIX fell 0.81 points; VIX's and SPX's moves explain a fall of about 0.46; the 0.35 left over is bigger than on 12 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, at or above the median, short of the top fifth, while SPX or VIX also moved (one or both 30-minute moves above the bottom third of the last sessions' at this minute)
labels.computed_how: residual = dVVIX30 - (a + b*SPX30 + c*dVIX30), fit on the prior sessions' half hours from 10:30 to 15:30 (a link fit, at least {min_rank_sessions} sessions); |residual| ranked against the fit's |residual| over the same half hour to this minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions, at least {same_clock_min_sessions}, else omitted; the barely-moved clause: SPX's 30-minute move (ranks.move_rank) and VIX's (vol.vix_change's rank of the diary VIX) each in the bottom third of the same half hour on up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions, at least {same_clock_min_sessions}, else omitted

labels.name: vol.vvix_with_move
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes SPX rose 0.13 sigma, larger than 16 of the last 19 sessions' 30-minute moves at this minute, top third, and VVIX fell 0.81 points, from 89.00 to 88.19
labels.computed_how: |30-minute SPX move| in the morning anchor ranked against the same half hour on up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions in their own anchors (ranks.move_rank), at least {same_clock_min_sessions}, else omitted; with the VVIX change

labels.name: volume.spy_last30_share
labels.example: SPY traded 10.8% of today's volume in the last 30 minutes, higher than 17 of the last 20 sessions at this minute, top third: heavy for this time
labels.computed_how: SPY volume last 30 min / volume since 09:30 from the siege box's minute volumes (siege/baseline.json), ranked against the same share at this minute on up to the last 20 sessions, needing same_clock_min_sessions, in thirds
labels.source: Schwab 1-min bars via market_context.py, saved by the context job to state/spx_jev/context/{day}.jsonl (live) and state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (backfill: python -m spx_jev.market_context --backfill 2026-08-10); the symbol must be in market_context.SYMBOLS (SPY)

labels.name: volume.spy_pace_30
labels.example: SPY traded 1.4 times its usual volume for this half hour, in the top fifth, higher than 19 of the last 20 sessions at this minute
labels.computed_how: SPY volume over the last 30 minutes from siege/baseline.json ranked against the same minutes on up to the last 20 sessions, needing same_clock_min_sessions, in fifths; its usual is their median
labels.source: Schwab 1-min bars via market_context.py, saved by the context job to state/spx_jev/context/{day}.jsonl (live) and state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (backfill: python -m spx_jev.market_context --backfill 2026-08-10); the symbol must be in market_context.SYMBOLS (SPY)

labels.name: xasset.bond_gap_30min
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes long Treasury prices (TLT) fell more than the index's move usually brings them, in the bottom fifth for this half hour, higher than 1 of the last 19 sessions at this minute; this hour bond prices and stocks moved together minute by minute (link +0.62, by size higher than 18 of the last 19 sessions at this minute, top third: tight enough to read): bond prices up has gone with stocks up; so bonds are ahead in the stocks-down direction; the Treasury cash market is open
labels.computed_how: TLT (or /ZN) 30-minute return minus 20-session beta x SPX, signed and ranked against the same measure at this clock on up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions, needing {same_clock_min_sessions} (else the label is omitted with the reason), in fifths; the correlation of 1-minute returns over the hour (the session so far before 10:31), its size ranked the same way, every session kept (a correlation is in no ruler; bottom third = loose), its sign in words; SIFMA bond-holiday clause (10-12 Columbus Day)
labels.source: Schwab 1-min bars via market_context.py, saved by the context job to state/spx_jev/context/{day}.jsonl (live) and state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (backfill: python -m spx_jev.market_context --backfill 2026-08-10); the symbol must be in market_context.SYMBOLS (TLT; /ZNZ26 fallback; neither yet in SYMBOLS or probed). The $TNX fallback is not usable after 15:00 (its bars stop at 14:59), so it is gone for the 15:02 and 15:32 reads

labels.name: xasset.macro_gap_30min
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes high-yield credit, gold and the euro ran above and bonds and oil ran below what the index's 0.14 sigma rise would match: taken together, each signed by how it moved with stocks this hour, the complex is ahead of the index in the stocks-up direction, in the top fifth for this half hour, higher than 17 of the last 20 sessions at this minute
labels.computed_how: average of standardized beta residuals for TLT, HYG, USO, GLD, /6E, each signed by today's 60-minute link, ranked against the same measure at this clock on up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions, needing {same_clock_min_sessions} (else the label is omitted with the reason), every session kept (each residual is in its own spread, no ruler), in fifths
labels.source: Schwab 1-min bars via market_context.py, saved by the context job to state/spx_jev/context/{day}.jsonl (live) and state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (backfill: python -m spx_jev.market_context --backfill 2026-08-10); the symbol must be in market_context.SYMBOLS (TLT, HYG, USO, /6EZ26, GLD: none yet in SYMBOLS or probed; 20-session betas need the backfill)

labels.name: xasset.oil_gap_30min
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes crude oil (USO) fell more than the index's move usually brings it, oil ran down: in the bottom fifth for this half hour, higher than 1 of the last 19 sessions at this minute
labels.computed_how: USO 30-minute return minus 20-session beta x SPX, signed and ranked against the same measure at this clock on up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions, needing {same_clock_min_sessions} (else the label is omitted with the reason), in fifths (avoid /CL roll ~10-20)
labels.source: Schwab 1-min bars via market_context.py, saved by the context job to state/spx_jev/context/{day}.jsonl (live) and state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (backfill: python -m spx_jev.market_context --backfill 2026-08-10); the symbol must be in market_context.SYMBOLS (USO; not yet in SYMBOLS or probed)

labels.name: premarket.where_now
labels.example: at 09:28 S&P futures are 0.31 sigma above their 16:00 price, higher than 16 of the last 20 nights at this time, top third; 85% of the way up the night's range
labels.computed_how: /ES's newest finished close by the read against the same contract's close at futures' 16:00 price, in the pre-open ruler (rulers.normal_day_sigma); |move| in percent ranked in thirds against the same clock over the last {night_rank_count} nights (at least {overnight_rank_min_nights}; roll, holiday and short nights skipped); position in the high-low range since 16:00; its figure's verdict is up, up_small, flat, down_small or down by the side and the third
labels.source: state/spx_jev/overnight/{day}.jsonl (Schwab /ES extended-hours 1-min, as seen at the checkpoint, contract stamped)

labels.name: premarket.arc
labels.example: the first leg that moved was Asia, up 0.24 sigma; futures now keep 129% of it, still above their 16:00 price: later trading built on it
labels.computed_how: first leg with |move| rank > {third_lo}; kept share = net now / that leg (stated as 'keep N%'); side of the 16:00 price now; net rank; verdict word by code
labels.source: state/spx_jev/overnight/{day}.jsonl (Schwab /ES extended-hours 1-min, as seen at the checkpoint, contract stamped)

labels.name: premarket.since_checkpoint
labels.example: since the 08:48 checkpoint futures fell 0.09 sigma, top third for 08:48-09:28 over the last 20 nights, against the night's rise, still above their 16:00 price: the latest leg gave back
labels.computed_how: /ES from the lane's previous SCHEDULED checkpoint (03:35 moves to 04:35 in the week Frankfurt is on winter time and New York is not) to now, rebuilt from bars (never from the previous read's record, never from the time a late read fired); ranked against the same clock window over the last {night_rank_count} nights; the night's net before the leg; cross check against futures' 16:00 price; in the pre-open ruler
labels.source: state/spx_jev/overnight/{day}.jsonl (Schwab /ES extended-hours 1-min, as seen at the checkpoint, contract stamped)

labels.name: premarket.legs
labels.example: oldest first: after hours quiet; Asia down 0.45 sigma; Europe's open up 0.05; Europe's morning down 0.18; before the report and the report window quiet; since 08:45 up 0.06 so far. 4 moved; the latest against the night's fall
labels.computed_how: the stretches of story.py tile futures' 16:00 price to the read: after the close (to 18:00), Asia (to Tokyo's close), Europe's open (to 30 minutes after Frankfurt's open), the Europe morning (to 08:00), before the report (to the release minute, 08:30 when there is none), the report window (to 08:45, every day) and the last stretch (to the read); exchange-local edges; each stretch's side and size in the pre-open ruler, ranked against the same stretch over the last {night_rank_count} nights: one in the bottom third is quiet, and quiet ones in a row are named together; no leg says its third or 'added' (latest_leg_vs_night's option, read beside it); on a morning with no report the two stretches around 08:30 are named by their clocks; only the running stretch says 'so far'; an edge price older than {window_10_min} minutes merges the stretch with its neighbour and says so; a stretch across a roll is left out; ends with the code verdict for night_legs_agree
labels.source: state/spx_jev/overnight/{day}.jsonl (Schwab /ES extended-hours 1-min, as seen at the checkpoint, contract stamped)

labels.name: premarket.release_vs_night
labels.example: futures are now 0.08 sigma below their 16:00 price; before the 08:30 jobs report they were 0.23 above, top third; the report's first 15 minutes fell 0.31, higher than 18 of the last 20 days in that window, and carried them across the 16:00 price
labels.computed_how: the net move from futures' 16:00 price at the release minute (story.release_minute) and at the report window's end (08:45); the report window's move ranked against the same window on all of the last {night_rank_count} days, report or not; the cross tested at 08:45; in the pre-open ruler
labels.source: the overnight store's /ES bars + calendar pre_open rows (listed and read from pre_open_covers_from, 2026-08-01)

labels.name: premarket.vs_last_hour
labels.example: futures are now 0.22 sigma above their 16:00 price, top third; yesterday SPX fell 0.30 sigma in its last hour, top third of the last 20 last hours: the night turned against yesterday's close
labels.computed_how: SPX 15:00-16:00 from saved SPX bars (state/reversion/bars), its |move| ranked over the last {night_rank_count} sessions (ranks.rank_sessions: at least {same_clock_min_sessions} of them, else omitted with the reason); /ES net since futures' 16:00 price as premarket.where_now, in the pre-open ruler
labels.source: saved SPX bars + the overnight store's /ES bars

labels.name: seq.day_move_by_read
labels.example: SPX is 0.11 sigma below the settled open; at the last 3 reads it stood -0.11 (10:02), -0.28 (10:32) and -0.11 (11:00); 62% of its furthest, at 10:32, has been given back, top third of the last 19 sessions for these reads: unwinding
labels.computed_how: (close at each earlier read minute - 09:34 close) / sigma_anchor, rebuilt from 1-min bars at the read minutes (not from saved records); the last four reads listed; the furthest point from the settled open, on either side, sought over every read since 10:02 and named with its size when it came before the listed reads; the share given back since, ranked at the same reads over up to the last {night_rank_count} prior sessions, at least {same_clock_min_sessions}; the questions sleep while the day's move ranks in the bottom third of the same move to this minute on those sessions (ranks.move_rank), which the sleep reason says

labels.name: seq.breadth_by_read
labels.example: SPX is 0.12 sigma above the settled open, at 11:02, 11:32 and 12:01 -0.07, -0.02 and +0.12, while the day's rising-stock volume share went 42%, 49% and 55%: 12 points toward the day's side, top third for these reads: building behind the move
labels.computed_how: cumulative $UVOL/($UVOL+$DVOL) since 09:30 at each read minute; change over the last three reads signed to the day's side; its size ranked at the same clock on up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions with the market context, at least {same_clock_min_sessions}

labels.name: overnight.btc_vs_futures
labels.example: S&P futures stand 0.31 sigma below their 16:00 price; since then bitcoin futures (/MBT) fell 1.9 of its normal nights to this time, 1.4 normal gaps below what the futures' move would match, bottom fifth of the last 20 nights; over those nights bitcoin up has gone with stocks up, so bitcoin is ahead in the stocks-down direction
labels.computed_how: bitcoin's percent move from the night's start to the read (the last bar finished by each time, neither over {window_10_min} minutes old) minus its usual multiple of the /ES percent move over the same span (fitted by bitcoin.slope over the same span to the same minute on the last {night_rank_count} nights); the night starts at the prior session's close (16:00, 13:00 after a half day), or on the first session after a weekend or holiday at the end of the S&P futures' first minute after their 18:00 reopen, so the weekend (weekend.btc_path) is left out and the sentence says 'since the S&P futures reopened at 18:00 Sunday'; ranked in fifths against the same span on the prior nights with both on one contract (at least {overnight_rank_min_nights}); 'normal night' = median |move| of those nights, for bitcoin and for its gap to the futures; the figure says in_line when the gap sits in the middle three fifths (the gate sleeps the question). Roll guard: Schwab's /BTC and /MBT history is one stitched front-month series; it switches contract at 18:00 ET on the Thursday before the last-Friday expiry and jumps up 0.28-0.53% against IBIT (7 of 7 rolls, Mar-Sep 2026), about a third of a normal night. The roll night is left out, and so is a read with a roll pending (rolls.pending).
labels.source: the overnight store (state/spx_jev/overnight/{day}.jsonl): Schwab /MBT (micro bitcoin futures) 1- and 5-minute bars with extended hours, contract stamped (the front contract: /MBTV26 now, /MBTX26 from 18:00 ET Thu 10-29); /BTC is saved beside it as a cross-check (the same price, under 5 bars an hour on Saturdays). /ES as in overnight_move_vs_expected.

labels.name: weekend.btc_path
labels.example: S&P futures stand 0.64 sigma above their 16:00 price; bitcoin futures (/MBT) fell 0.4 of its normal weekends from the Friday 16:00 close to the S&P futures' reopen at 18:00 Sunday, larger than 4 of the last 15 weekends by size, bottom third; since the reopen it has moved 4.0 of a normal reopen leg back against it, bottom third of those weekends' reopen legs taken their weekend's way: it turned back
labels.computed_how: two bitcoin legs, each a percent move between the last bars finished by the two times: the weekend leg from the prior session's close (16:00, or 13:00 after a half day) to the S&P futures' reopen after their longest halt since that close, found in their bars (Sunday 18:00 after a weekend), and the reopen leg from there to the read. A price at the close or the read over {window_10_min} minutes old, or at the reopen over {window_60_min}, leaves it out. The weekend leg is ranked by size against the last {night_rank_count} weekends, the top third a big weekend, (the first sessions after a weekend or holiday); the reopen leg, taken the weekend leg's way, in thirds against those weekends' reopen legs taken theirs: extended in the top third, reversed in the bottom, held between. Each is said in shares of its own median |leg| over those weekends; the sentence opens with where the S&P futures stand against their 16:00 price. Roll guard: Schwab's /BTC and /MBT history is one stitched front-month series; it switches contract at 18:00 ET on the Thursday before the last-Friday expiry and jumps up 0.28-0.53% against IBIT (7 of 7 rolls, Mar-Sep 2026), about a third of a normal night. The roll night is left out, and so is a read with a roll pending (rolls.pending).
labels.source: the overnight store (state/spx_jev/overnight/{day}.jsonl): Schwab /MBT (micro bitcoin futures) 1- and 5-minute bars with extended hours, contract stamped (the front contract: /MBTV26 now, /MBTX26 from 18:00 ET Thu 10-29); /BTC is saved beside it as a cross-check (the same price, under 5 bars an hour on Saturdays). Before 2026-05-29 CME bitcoin futures were shut Fri 17:00 to Sun 18:00 ET, so older weekends have only the Sunday reopen gap and no path; only weekends from 2026-05-29 are ranked.

labels.name: xasset.btc_gap_30min
labels.example: over the last 30 minutes bitcoin futures (/MBT) rose 1.7 times its normal half-hour gap more than the index's move usually brings it, in the top fifth for this half hour, higher than 17 of the last 20 sessions at this minute; over the last 20 sessions bitcoin up has gone with stocks up, so bitcoin is ahead in the stocks-up direction
labels.computed_how: bitcoin's 30-minute return minus its usual multiple of the index's x SPX's 30-minute return, both simple returns between the last prices known at the two times (usual_link: the least-squares slope of bitcoin's 30-minute returns on SPX's over the half hours from 10:00 to 16:00 of the prior sessions on file, up to {night_rank_count}); ranked in fifths against the same half hour on the prior sessions; 'normal half-hour gap' = median |excess| of those; the sentence closes with the side the multiple points to (bitcoin up has gone with stocks up or down), which sets the answer's direction
labels.source: today: /MBT quoted under its root by the market-context job (market_context.py, state/spx_jev/context/{day}.jsonl); prior sessions: the overnight store's /MBT bars (each night file holds its day's session, state/spx_jev/overnight/).

labels.name: xasset.btc_gap_streak
labels.example: in each of the last three half-hours (10:32, 11:02, 11:32) bitcoin fell further than the index's move would match; together that is 2.3 times a normal 90-minute gap, bottom third at this time of day over the last 20 sessions
labels.computed_how: the three latest xasset.btc_gap_30min excesses with their signs, summed, and the sum ranked against the same clock over the prior 20 sessions; shares of the median |90-minute excess|

labels.name: xasset.btc_link
labels.example: since 09:35 bitcoin futures (/MBT) and the index have moved together five minutes by five minutes more tightly than on most recent sessions: link +0.62, higher than 17 of the last 20 sessions at this minute, top third; over the last 20 sessions bitcoin up has gone with stocks up
labels.computed_how: correlation of 5-minute returns (bitcoin vs SPX) from 09:35 to now, ranked against the same span on the prior 20 sessions; sign of the 20-session beta in words

labels.name: xasset.btc_five_day
labels.example: over the last 5 sessions bitcoin futures (/MBT) did 3.2 normal weeks better than the index's move would match, in the top fifth of the last 15 5-session stretches, higher than 14 of them; the index itself rose 0.8 of its normal week
labels.computed_how: bitcoin's simple return over the last five sessions, close to close (the index's last bar at each session's close, 16:00 or 13:00 on a half day, and bitcoin's newest bar within {window_10_min} minutes before it), minus its usual multiple of the index's x SPX's five-session return; the multiple is fitted (bitcoin.slope) on bitcoin's daily returns against SPX's over the last {night_rank_count} + 5 sessions with both on one contract; ranked in fifths against the five sessions ending on each of up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions before, needing {same_clock_min_sessions} of them; 'normal week' = median |five-session excess| over those; it sleeps while a roll is pending, and leaves the Thursday roll evening out of its daily moves
labels.source: the overnight store's /MBT bars at each prior session's 16:00 (its nights reach back to March) and SPX's saved closes (state/reversion/bars); the roll guard applies (a five-session window across a /MBT roll is left out)

labels.name: open.chop
labels.example: since the settled open 25 minutes ago price travelled 0.45 sigma to end 0.03 sigma below it (path efficiency 0.07, the net move over the distance travelled) and crossed it 4 times; that path is more one-way than 6 of the last 20 sessions at this minute, bottom third: choppy
labels.computed_how: path efficiency (measures.path_efficiency) of the 1-minute closes from the settled open (the 09:34 close) to the last finished bar: |net move| over the distance travelled close to close, 0 to 1; ranked against the same path efficiency from each prior session's own settled open to this clock minute on up to the last {night_rank_count} sessions (every session whose closes moved counts: a share, not in sigma, so an estimated ruler does not leave a day out; a tie is not beaten), said as 'more one-way than N of the last M sessions at this minute' and its third, bottom choppy / middle mixed / top one-way ('no more one-way than any' when it beats none); the distance travelled and the net move in sigma and the crossings of the open are said beside it as facts; omitted before 09:45 ('the path since the open is judged from 09:45, when ten minutes of it exist'), when price has not moved from the settled open, and under {same_clock_min_sessions} sessions with the rank's reason

retired.reason: its 'proof' showed only that it almost never fires (true on 0 of 1,467 up-day reads, 3% of down-day reads), not that it fails to help; retired as a question and merged into a code cross of book_balance_agreement x the day's side from the open, which code computes without asking JEV.
